name: docket
description: Keeps Claude's open questions, confirmations and hand-offs in numbered lists in a pane beside the chat, answerable by label or by button

display.title: Display
display.description: A pane beside the transcript, or a band above the prompt

pinnedCap.title: Pinned cap
pinnedCap.description: Items shown in pinned before "+N more"

waitingCap.title: Waiting cap
waitingCap.description: Items shown in waiting before "+N more"

laterCap.title: Later cap
laterCap.description: Items shown in Later before "+N more"

underwayCap.title: Underway cap
underwayCap.description: Items shown in underway before "+N more"

viewCap.title: View cap
viewCap.description: Items shown in view before "+N more"

needsYouCap.title: Needs you cap
needsYouCap.description: Items shown in needs you before "+N more"

confirmCap.title: Confirm cap
confirmCap.description: Items shown in confirm before "+N more"

questionsCap.title: Questions cap
questionsCap.description: Items shown in questions before "+N more"

requestsCap.title: Requests cap
requestsCap.description: Items shown in requests before "+N more"

emoji.title: Emoji
emoji.description: Master switch for every emoji the docket draws

headingEmoji.title: Heading emoji
headingEmoji.description: An emoji before each list's heading

noItemEmojiLists.title: Lists without item emoji
noItemEmojiLists.description: Letters of lists whose items draw no emoji, e.g. "Q,P"

inlineLists.title: Inline lists
inlineLists.description: Letters of lists drawn on one line, separated by dots

targetWords.title: Target lengths
targetWords.description: Soft word limits per list, e.g. "P=8,Q=30"

itemColor.title: Item color
itemColor.description: Color of an item changed this turn, a hex or a theme key

itemDimColor.title: Dimmed item color
itemDimColor.description: Color of an item unchanged since the last turn

leanColor.title: Lean color
leanColor.description: Color of the lean line, a hex or a theme key; empty for the item's own color

leanDimColor.title: Dimmed lean color
leanDimColor.description: Color of the lean line while its item is dimmed as unchanged

answeredLingerSeconds.title: Answered linger
answeredLingerSeconds.description: Seconds an item answered by button stays up, dimmed, before it goes

strikeLingerMinutes.title: Strike linger
strikeLingerMinutes.description: Minutes an item Claude closed on its own stays up struck through
